title: A pole lathe runs on leg power, and a one-day class can send you home with a rolling pin
alt: A rough wooden bench with a pivoting clamping head, standing on a floor covered in wood shavings.

posts.facebook:
No electricity needed: a pole lathe is powered by your own leg.

You press a pedal, and the spring of a thin pole turns the wood while you shape it with chisels. Green woodworking uses freshly felled wood, worked with axes, drawknives (two-handled blades) and a shaving horse, a bench that grips the wood while you shape it.

A one-day taster can send you home with a rolling pin, a honey drizzler or a small mallet. In the UK, the Association of Pole-lathe Turners and Green Woodworkers, known as the Bodgers, maps local groups near you.

What would you make first?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/try-green-woodworking/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
